text: As artificial intelligence becomes part of our daily lives, ethical questions are more important than ever. One major concern is bias: if AI systems learn from unfair data, they can make unfair decisions about jobs, loans, or healthcare. Fairness means treating all people equally, regardless of their background. Privacy is another key issue, because AI often collects and uses personal information. Companies must protect this data and use it responsibly. Transparency also matters: people should understand how AI makes decisions that affect them. Finally, responsible AI development means designers, companies, and governments must work together to create technology that helps society without causing harm.
